g.data-semantic-relation: turn the ROI into a declared multiscale feature recipe
g.data-must-show: test 與 normal ROI 共用 recipe | fixed image encoder | selected multi-scale feature maps | ROI/resize/normalization/layer 版本標籤
g.data-not-claim: 特徵路徑可不受 ROI、layer 或正規化設定影響。
g.title: ROI 先變多尺度 feature

g.data-semantic-relation: recover a normal-like feature with the declared decoder
g.data-must-show: 輸入 multi-scale feature | normal-trained SSM decoder | 對應尺度的 recovered feature | input/recovered 的 distance 箭頭
g.data-not-claim: recovered feature 是原始工件的真實無缺陷樣子。
g.title: 反推 normal-like feature
